title: Bhopal experiences heavy rainfall, rescues, and fuel contamination incident
summary: Bhopal received 7.5 inches of rain in 36 hours, fulfilling half of August's average rainfall in one night. Heavy rainfall led to the rescue of seven youths stranded in a strong current at the Kajli Kheda picnic spot by SDRF and police. Schools remained closed for the third consecutive day due to the downpour. Separately, a protest erupted at Bhopal petrol pumps after customers reported finding petrol mixed with water, leading to the sealing of two pumps.
summary_points: Bhopal recorded 7.5 inches of rainfall in 36 hours, meeting half of August's average rainfall in a single night.
Seven youths were rescued by SDRF and police after being trapped in a strong current at the Kajli Kheda picnic spot.
Schools in Bhopal were closed for a third consecutive day due to the heavy rains.
Customers at Bhopal petrol pumps reported finding water mixed with petrol.
Two petrol pumps were sealed following customer complaints of contaminated fuel.
title_hi: भोपाल में भारी बारिश, बचाव कार्य और ईंधन संदूषण की घटना
